name: Eisenhower Matrix
description: Prioritization method based on urgency and importance

name: Time Blocking
steps: Define blocks, assign tasks, follow schedule

name: Eat the Frog
steps: Identify hardest task, complete it first

name: SMART Goals
steps: Make goals specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, time-bound

name: 2-Minute Rule
steps: If task <2 minutes, do it now

name: Kanban
steps: Create board, add tasks, move through stages

name: Habit Stacking
description: Attach new habits to existing ones
steps: Choose anchor habit, add new habit

name: Focus Timer
steps: Set timer, work until it ends
